draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.31, the 45th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 1st of 18 at TE. He lasted until pick 106, well after his grade rank (45th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 250 receiving yards in 2021, 14th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 63 career games and 58 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 87.6% (99th percentile), drop rate 1.2% (89th percentile), team target share 15.0% (86th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 572 receiving yards against a median of 179, above the norm.
